title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — November 07, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C4.9 (Peaked November 07, 2026 at 03:36 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: C5.9 (Peaked November 07, 2026 at 00:53 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 438 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.00)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Some C-Class activity! 🔥🚀

Several active regions and a broad dark coronal structure are visible in today’s solar images, while no clear large outward structure appears in the coronagraph.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 193 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
